seed_scope: the seed ID controls data order; generation sampling is not seeded (the rollout engine's random seed is left unset)
loop_definition: a completion counts as a loop when one 20-400 character unit taken from its end repeats at least max(3, 1500/len(unit)) times within its last 3000 characters

token_limit.definition: an answer is at the limit when its text, tokenized again with the checkpoint's tokenizer, has at least 97% of the benchmark's generation limit (16384 tokens for MATH-500, 32768 for AIME)
token_limit.grades: each answer graded again as the benchmark grades it; the regrade reproduces the per-prompt accuracy of all 81 evaluation files

derived_from.kept: counts recovered from its four-decimal rates and checked against the per-prompt scores in this bundle
